notes.zh-CN: 浏览器与对话关联：每个对话在 GrokX 运行期间保留自己的标签页、当前页面和浏览器开关；切换对话会恢复对应页面，后台对话独立浏览，删除对话会关闭其标签页。网站登录仍使用共享浏览器配置。本次仅提供 Windows x64 与 ARM64 安装包，功能与 0.41.0 相同；macOS universal 未重新打包，最新的 macOS 安装包仍是 0.41.0。
notes.en: Browser tabs, the active page and the pane toggle are per conversation: switching chats restores their pages, background agents browse independently, and deleting a chat closes its tabs. Website sign-ins still use the shared browser profile. This release ships Windows x64 and ARM64 installers only, with the same features as 0.41.0; the macOS universal build was not rebuilt, so the latest macOS installer remains 0.41.0.
